dlsuProceedings.title: Invasion stages of Pterygoplichthys spp. (Pisces: Loricariidae) in the Luzon Island, Philippines
dlsuProceedings.citation: Chavez, J. M., & Carandang, J. R. (2014). DLSU Research Congress 2014, 64-70.
dlsuProceedings.recordSays: The proceeding abstract describes taxonomic, waterway and interview surveys at eight Luzon sites; the repository says the upload is unavailable.

authorPreprint.title: Invasion Status of Pterygoplichthys spp. (Pisces: Loricariidae) in the Luzon Island, Philippines and its Policy Implications
authorPreprint.citation: Chavez, J. M., & Carandang, J. R. (2017). Author-uploaded preprint; ResearchGate records the full text as uploaded by Joel Chavez on 2019-03-20.
authorPreprint.peerReviewStatus: ResearchGate labels this a preprint and warns that preprints may not have been peer reviewed.
authorPreprint.fieldMethodSummary: The authors say they inspected reported sites, interviewed residents and officials, determined study-site coordinates with Garmin GPS, and photographed available specimens dorsally, laterally and ventrally.
authorPreprint.angatSectionSummary: Section 3.4 describes a visit to Barangay Marungko, Angat River, reports net-caught specimens held at a fisher's hut, identifies the samples as Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus, and attributes the statement that catches had occurred since 2005 to interviews with fishers.

pjsSummary.title: New Locality Record of the Invasive Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus (Weber, 1991) on RAMSAR-listed Lake Naujan, the Philippines
pjsSummary.publisherPageAccess: Publisher article page returned HTTP 403 during this review; indexed publisher metadata and a ResearchGate-hosted full-text copy were inspected. No PDF was saved.

localityLead.coordinateMeaning: Study-site coordinate printed for Barangay Marungko; it is not an occurrence-point voucher coordinate or a waterbody boundary.
localityLead.sampleDescription: The manuscript says net-caught samples were at a fisher's hut and had been caught about one month before the authors' visit; the visit date is not specified.
localityLead.primarySourceWording: Fishers interviewed by the authors said catches had occurred in that area since 2005.
localityLead.secondarySourceConflict: The 2025 Lake Naujan article's Table 1 labels 2005 as year of introduction; its Angat row is secondary and does not document an Angat survey.
localityLead.provenance: Section 3.4 of the author-uploaded 2017 preprint reports the site visit, specimens and interview; the 2014 DLSU proceeding remains separately unavailable and is not proven identical to this preprint.

limits: The DLSU repository confirms a 2014 conference proceeding and its abstract but marks the uploaded full text unavailable.
The 2017 item is an author-uploaded preprint that ResearchGate labels as not necessarily peer reviewed; its identity with the separate 2014 DLSU proceeding was not established.
The preprint gives a study-site coordinate and a species identification but no visit date, specimen voucher/catalog number, or independently checkable identification evidence for the Angat samples.

The preprint attributes 'caught since 2005' to fisher interviews. This is a reported historical catch-start year, not a verified first introduction date, exact observation date, or current presence claim; the 2025 table's 'year of introduction' label conflicts in meaning.
ResearchGate says full-text content may be subject to copyright; author upload and public access do not grant reuse rights. No source-table content was republished into Bangwit application data.

rights.disposition: Rights are unresolved; preserve citation and factual review metadata only, and do not reproduce figures, tables, or manuscript text.

nextStep: Seek an independently reviewable, rights-cleared Angat specimen record or a voucher/checkable taxonomic source. Keep this preprint's historical field report separate from current occurrence, legal advice, safety, and the Bustos study reach.
